Make the Update Policy call without one or more of the parameters describing
what to modify: sections , sections_to_delete , apply_to_apps , or
apply_to_groups_in_apps ?
•
The API call makes the changes you specify in the input, but all the parameters
are optional.
◦
If you make the call with no changes in any of the parameters, the call returns
the (unchanged) policy.
◦
Add a policy section  (such as authorized_networks ) to a custom policy?
•
The API enables the section (that is, makes it active in the policy) and sets the
valid values you specify. Any key/value pairs not specified for the section will
be set to their default values.
◦
If you add a blank policy section, it will be enabled for the policy with default
values.
◦
Modify values for an existing policy section ?
•
The API changes only the values you specify.
